title: Merge lock and env-file records match the code
why: Lane refusal-uncited-rewrites' record-writer found four places where a record or usage line says one thing and the code does another.
note: (a) The merge lock's take expiry is not capped by its max hold. (b) The env-file write refusal for .envrc differs from the shell form. (c) decision standing-merge-grant cites a 600 s lock cap the code does not have. (d) The --unlock usage line says it reads no lock state, but it does. The lane reads which side its decision protects; the owner is asked only where no record says. Ready. Port: yes.
